features.title: Linked storage
features.blurb: Solo native combined chest grid for up to four containers explicitly linked to one workbench. Chopping-block range and connection effect; crafting, item upgrades and construction from linked contents.
features.effect: unity-storage-start : (List StorageSlot, Integer -> StoragePlan), (List StorageSlot, Integer -> StoragePlan) -> [Process] Nothing

features.title: Meadows neck populations
features.blurb: Keep the natural initial Meadows neck population. Once you start clearing it, replacements stop; fully cleared areas recover after a saved seven to fourteen Valheim days.

features.title: Circumhorizontal arc
features.blurb: A distant cirrus spectrum from 09:00 to 15:00 game time, behind foreground clouds, on the first day and every seventh day after, in clear weather.

features.title: Station and taming timers
features.blurb: Hovering a smelter, kiln, blast furnace or refinery shows when the next item finishes and when the queue is done, including when the fuel runs out; a fermenter shows when it is ready; an animal being tamed shows the time left and when to feed it again.
features.effect: unity-station-hover-start : (Integer, Integer, Integer, Integer, Integer, Integer -> Text), (Integer, Integer -> Text), (Integer, Integer -> Text) -> [Process] Nothing

features.title: Centred health and food
features.blurb: The health bar lies flat and centred just below the stamina bar, with the three eaten foods beneath it. Left Alt+1/2/3 repeats those foods, unless dedicated loadout slots are selected; then those keys use the dedicated food slots.
features.effect: unity-hud-layout-start : (Integer -> Integer), (Integer, Integer -> Integer), (Integer -> Integer) -> [Process] Nothing

features.title: Planting in rows
features.blurb: Plant rows with the cultivator, or with the hoe when Shovel and hoe is also selected. Farming skill increases row length. Each plant uses its own seed, stamina and tool wear; grey ghosts mark blocked spots.

features.title: Shovel and hoe
features.blurb: Turn the cultivator into a copper shovel for digging, shaping ground and paths. The hoe cultivates, clears, smooths and plants crops, saplings and decorative greenery. Add Planting in rows to plant rows with the hoe; otherwise it plants one at a time.

features.title: Harvest and replant
features.blurb: Shift + Use harvests nearby mature crops and forage. Add Ctrl to replant crops when holding a planting tool, paying seeds, stamina and tool wear for each plant. Adds growth-time hover text and extra cultivator plants; with Shovel and hoe, those plants stay on the hoe.

features.title: Torch and campfire refuelling
features.blurb: Chests within 10 metres of a standing torch or campfire supply its resin or wood in the loaded area near you. Consumes real fuel, respects chest access, and leaves other fires and production stations unchanged.

features.title: Flying build camera
features.blurb: Press F8 in placement mode with a building tool. Fly with WASD, Space/Ctrl and Shift for speed; F8 returns to your character. Materials, building rules and player vulnerability still apply. No terrain-radius changes, automatic repairs or structural overlay.

features.title: Armour, food, mead and ammo slots
features.blurb: Opening inventory shows a separate central Equipment panel, in the game's own window style, with vertical columns for head/torso/legs/back, three food, three mead and four ammo stacks. Drag matching items into the slots; armour placed there equips. Click Select above an ammo stack to equip it; ACTIVE marks your choice. Alt+1/2/3 uses the food slots and Alt+4/5/6 uses mead. Equipped armour is restored after upgrading. Tools, weapons, shields and other wearables use ordinary inventory. Empty extra slots before disabling this option.
